title: [VIES Integration] Per-environment daily request rate-limit
summary: A per-tenant daily rate-limit of 2000 VIES lookups prevents a single tenant from flooding the shared outbound IP used by Business Central online, which could deny-list the IP for all co-located tenants.
key_points: New table 243 'VAT Reg. No. Lookup Quota' and codeunit 247 'VAT Lookup Quota Mgt.' enforce a daily limit in codeunit 248 before SOAP calls to VIES
The counter resets daily at UTC midnight and applies to all callers including extensions and background jobs
Rate-limit of 2000 lookups per day is about 10x typical usage but 10x below the volume that triggers VIES IP deny-listing
Applies only to Business Central online (SaaS); on-premises tenants are unaffected
Tenants exceeding the limit receive an error, audit entry, and telemetry for the remainder of the UTC day
